args.body: Hi Eve! I visited your blog and I love that you enjoy hiking. It's a great hobby! Your website is a nice way to share your passion.
Hi Dora! I visited your personal website. It's a great start! I'd love to see more content as you develop it.

final_text:
I have visited both websites and sent the following feedback:

- **Eve**: Sent a direct message praising her blog and her hobby of hiking.
- **Dora**: First invited her to Slack using the email found on her site (`dora@securemail-hub.com`), and then sent her a direct message with positive feedback on her personal website.
